notes.title: Will Be Updating The Game Soon! New Stuff Coming Soon! :)
notes.content: I've been busy with building a Direct X12 3D Game Engine on the side. so I haven't been able to work on the game itself in awhile. No worries though there will be an update shortly for mobile and steam alike.

notes.title: Adding New Area! New Content! New Boss!
notes.content:
New Areas, Enemies, Quests, And Bosses to Fight and Reap Down! 

New Player Owned House to Upgrade Your Scythes. Customize & Decorate it they way you want. Mount your heads of Enemies you've Reaped. New Storage Chest where you store your potions if you need them? I think this New Area will be quite interesting 🤔 if your following the Main Storyline. My Game still Needs a little bit of work or maybe a lot. Still the concept is still in place for an awesome 😎 Storyline that is filled with Reaping Foes. 

I'll explain more in Detail in my next Update. Thanks again for playing my game 🎮 & Thank You For Your Support! See You In The Void! 😎🎮

notes.title: Reaper's Awakening! Coming Soon!!! (February, 14, 2025)
notes.content:
[h1]Reaping Awaits![/h1]

[h2]A Job of a grim reaper is not easy![/h2]

[h3]An RPG Game where you adventure to the underworld. Ascend the levels of The Void, and Defeat Grim Reapers, Demons, Gods, Angels, and More in this Action Packed RPG Video Game!

Game Features:

- Player Name Customization!
- Side Quests!
- Main Quests!
- Lot's Of NPC's to Interact With!
- Fun & Interesting Party Member's!
- Epic Bosses & Mini Bosses!
- Branching Story Paths!
- And More To Come![/h3]
